The '''''Dodonna's Pride''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] named for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]. The [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] used the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in a series of hit-and-run raids on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supply convoys during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
